name: En-hakkore
line: En-hakkore is a spring in Lehi that God opened for thirsty Samson, and its name, "fountain of the crier," recalls the cry he made to God.

moments.title: Water for thirsty Samson
moments.text: Samson was very thirsty and cried out to the LORD, asking if he must now die of thirst. God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out, and when Samson drank, his strength returned and he was revived.

moments.title: A spring with a name
moments.text: Samson named the spring En-hakkore because of what happened there. The verse says it remains in Lehi to this day.
